messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action in the source video to the action demonstrated in the motion reference. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's action to the one demonstrated in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands mostly still, then briefly raises her hands to adjust the front of her top before lowering them again.","camera":"A high-angle, full-body shot remains static throughout the clip.","clothing":"She wears a brown patterned lace crop top, light gray wide-leg pants, and black slide sandals.","hair_color":"Pink.","hairstyle":"Hair is pulled back into a low ponytail with straight bangs across the forehead.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build and light skin.","scene":"The character stands on a cracked, sandy ground in bright sunlight, casting a long shadow to the left, with a dark wall and a colorful object in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output character now performs a similar sequence: standing, then raising her hands to touch/adjust the front of her top around the middle of the clip, then lowering them. Her pink hair, brown lace top, gray pants, sandals, outdoor scene, lighting, and static high-angle framing remain consistent with the source.
arguments.requested_change: Change the source character's action to match the motion reference, while preserving her identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: Exact timing and subtle body mechanics of the transferred motion cannot be verified frame-by-frame against the reference.
